briefs.topic: Humanoid robots move from backflips to useful work
briefs.source_note: Reuters reported on 2026-08-18 that attention at the World Robot Conference is shifting from spectacular demonstrations toward practical productivity and commercial value. The meme borrows only this demo-versus-delivery tension.
briefs.conflict: spectacular demo tricks versus useful end-to-end work
briefs.comparison_target: 只会展示单项能力的热门 AI 工具

panels.caption: 热门 AI：看我再来一个后空翻
panels.visual: original generic exhibition robot performing a flashy harmless trick on a small stage, no identifiable real robot design

panels.caption: 老板：活呢？
panels.visual: same fictional expo, a desk still piled with research, copy, review and coding tasks

panels.caption: InkClawAgent：表演结束，开始串流程
panels.visual: abstract orchestration board routes SEARCH, WRITE, REVIEW and CODE lanes toward one deliverable

panels.caption: 会一招很酷，能交付才有用。
panels.visual: completed project package rolls off the workflow while the demo stage goes quiet

punchlines: 会一招很酷，能交付才有用。
Demo 能上热搜，交付才能下班。
briefs.negative_prompt: Unitree likeness, UBTECH likeness, real robot product shapes, company logos, copied conference booth, exact Reuters imagery

briefs.topic: Rocket launches become mass tourism spectacles in China
briefs.source_note: Reuters reported on 2026-08-19 that rocket launches around Wenchang are increasingly public tourism spectacles. The meme uses the universal launch-versus-mission-control structure, not real launch hardware or branding.
briefs.conflict: a spectacular launch moment versus the less glamorous mission-control work that gets a mission to its destination
briefs.comparison_target: 只负责点火的单点 AI

panels.caption: 所有人：3、2、1，AI 起飞！
panels.visual: original fictional rocket festival at dusk, generic unbranded rocket silhouette, crowds filming from a safe distance

panels.caption: 十分钟后：所以任务飞去哪了？
panels.visual: rocket trail disappears while four disconnected task folders float around confused operators

panels.caption: InkClawAgent：Research → Write → Review → Code，按轨道走
panels.visual: fictional mission-control room with four clean workflow orbits converging on one destination

panels.caption: 点火是热点，抵达才是结果。
panels.visual: abstract project capsule reaches a clearly labeled DELIVERED orbit, no real spacecraft design

punchlines: 点火是热点，抵达才是结果。
会起飞不稀奇，会把任务送到终点才行。
briefs.negative_prompt: real Chinese rocket models, CNSA logos, launch-site replica, national flags as focal imagery, exact Reuters photo composition

briefs.source_note: SocialPilot's August 14-25 trend roundup describes an ongoing '2026 is the new 2016' nostalgia format built around then-versus-now edits. This is a lower-confidence trend-monitoring source, so the brief treats it as a format signal rather than a factual market claim.
briefs.conflict: nostalgic then-versus-now comparison applied to fragmented AI workflows

panels.caption: 2016：复制、粘贴、开 12 个标签页
panels.visual: original retro desktop scene with generic browser windows and sticky notes, no copied operating-system UI

panels.caption: 2026：复制、粘贴、开 12 个 AI……
panels.visual: same original desk upgraded with twelve generic glowing AI cards, user expression unchanged

panels.caption: InkClawAgent：你确定这叫升级？
panels.visual: one clean orchestration workspace groups research, writing, review and code into a coordinated flow

panels.caption: 换工具不叫进化，换工作流才叫。
panels.visual: split-screen original then-versus-now composition ending on a single completed deliverable

punchlines: 换工具不叫进化，换工作流才叫。
2026 了，别把 12 个标签页换成 12 个 AI。
briefs.negative_prompt: TikTok UI, TikTok logo, copyrighted music lyrics, real creator faces, copied 2016 meme imagery, recognizable OS screenshots
